about: Six SSP scenarios after 2024: fossil emissions (GtC/yr), smog forcing and every other non-CO2 forcing (W/m2). Each starts from the measured 2024 value and returns to the scenario over 20 years. After 2500: no emissions, forcing held.

sources: RCMIP v5.1.0: Nicholls et al. (2020), Geoscientific Model Development 13, 5175-5190, doi:10.5194/gmd-13-5175-2020; protocol data doi:10.5281/zenodo.4589756 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Extensions after 2100 follow Meinshausen et al. (2020), Geoscientific Model Development 13, 3571-3605, doi:10.5194/gmd-13-3571-2020.
Fossil emissions are RCMIP's "Fossil and Industrial" CO2; other forcing is its anthropogenic total less CO2 and aerosols.
